document.title: Free public transport
document.question:
Some people think that public transport in cities should be free for everyone and paid for through taxes. Others believe that passengers should pay for the transport they use.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
